notes: Power budget 0–8.6 dB; path penalty 2.9 dB stated separately from power budget. Transmitter/receiver power values are average power (footnote 3). Minimum input power per lane -12.6 dBm and overload +2.0 dBm per lane specified at BER 5×10^-5 (footnote 4). FEC required by host per IEEE802.3bj RS(528,514); optical parameters yield BER 5×10^-5, FEC achieves better than 1×10^-12. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C (not normal operating). 12-fiber ribbon SM cable; single 12 lane optical fiber MPO/MTP connector interface.
suggestions: Datasheet does not state emitter/photodetector types, modulation format, or host/media interface IDs; path penalty 2.9 dB has no paired penalized optical parameter row for penalties[] schema.
